title: Inviolata integra (Courtois)
desc: Jean Courtois, Inviolata integra, before 1532. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0039); edited by Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
